name: senior-single-phaseout
description: Single filer age 65+ in the 6% phase-out range of the OBBBA enhanced deduction for seniors: $6,000 reduced by 6% of MAGI over $75,000, on top of the 65+ additional standard deduction.

source.publication: Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part V 'Enhanced Deduction for Seniors', lines 31-37; Instructions for Form 1040 (2025)
source.pin: Worksheet lines 31-37 verbatim: 'Enter $75,000 ($150,000 if married filing jointly)... Subtract line 32 from line 31... Multiply line 33 by 6% (0.06)... Subtract line 34 from $6,000. If zero or less, enter -0-.' Additional standard deduction $2,000 (single 65+), VITA Standard Deduction page.

derivation: Wages $100,000 = MAGI (Part I of Schedule 1-A; no Puerto Rico / Form 2555 items).
Standard deduction total = 15,750 + 2,000 (65+ single) + 4,500 = $22,250; taxable income = $77,750.
NIIT $0 (MAGI under $200,000, no investment income). Total tax $12,019.00.
